cuenta.cuerpo: This is where you change your password, pick your language and see which devices are signed in. If you see one you don't recognise, close it.

portadaDiscover.cuerpo: The first thing you see: the course you left half-finished, your points and what's still pending.

laboratorio.cuerpo: The robots you can build with your kits, and the two official environments for programming them.

biblioteca.cuerpo: Your kit's tutorials and worksheets. Almost everything you'll do starts here.

actividades.cuerpo: Your challenges and assessments. Opening one to see how you did costs no attempt: an attempt is only used when you press to answer.

logros.cuerpo: Your badges and your level, with what's left to reach the next one. You only compare against yourself.

portadaAcademy.cuerpo: Your figures, your technology path and what lies ahead.

cursos.cuerpo: The content you have activated, with your progress lesson by lesson.

evaluacionesAlumno.cuerpo: Opening one to see your grade uses no attempt: an attempt is only used when you press to answer.

progreso.cuerpo: Your average in the kit's assessments and in your teacher's, kept apart, and how much you have improved since your first attempt.

panelDocente.cuerpo: Your classrooms, how many seats are left and how many submissions you have to grade.

crearSalon.cuerpo: The grade you choose decides which kit its students can activate, so it pays to get it right first time.

evaluacionesDocente.cuerpo: The GLEXCO bank comes with the kit and is the same in every school: it can't be edited, but you can duplicate it to adapt it.

anunciosDocente.cuerpo: Whatever you post here, your students see on their home screen.

clase.cuerpo: Who has activated their kit and who has fallen behind. These are the two signals that arrive before the first exam, while there is still something to be done.
